failure_modes: If the observed-window sign changes in landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy are noise rather than a reproducible time-conditioned contrast, the 0.5 blend will displace surrounding coordinates without affinity benefit; the static endpoint term limits but does not eliminate this.

Blend=0.5 still injects a temporal coordinate reward; if the observed-teacher contrast is misaligned with final affinity, unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates can occur, which is why blend=1.0 (pure temporal) was rejected.
No decoded terminal labels are supplied, so the immediate-versus-descendant direction disagreement (H003) cannot be resolved; the chosen blend is a bounded hedge, not a demonstrated affinity gain.
Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed or evaluated.
rationale: Analyst F003/H001 show the observed-window coordinate contrasts are non-monotone (landmark_00_soft_mass: 4 sign changes, first_rate_z positive, last_rate_z negative; landmark_00_local_dy: 6 sign changes, opposite rate signs), with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation. A stationary coordinate target therefore cannot match the observed window, so the registered time-conditioned alternative is the defensible edit. Among the offered temporal choices, C010 (temporal_teacher_blend=0.5) is preferred over C009 (0.25) and C011 (1.0): the joint diagnostics show teacher_contrast_coherence whole-window mean near 0.81 with positive batch fraction 1.0 and teacher_contrast_RMS_A positive in all batches (F005), i.e. the observed-teacher contrast is coherent but the static endpoint reward is the incumbent's primary affinity signal; an even blend keeps the shared FLOWR endpoint reward and the shared learned support while conditioning regional attention on observed score nodes, whereas blend=1.0 would discard the static endpoint term entirely and blend=0.25 would under-use the coherent temporal signal. This changes only the registered temporal_teacher scalar/attention recipe (teacher coordinates unchanged, no velocity target, no temperature edit), consistent with the affinity-first objective. H003's disagreement between observed_child_score_gain (negative, zero positive batch fraction) and innovation_native_alignment (positive) is why I do not set direction from last-record credit alone and keep the static endpoint reward in the mixture rather than replacing it.
